const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+import math
+import os
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+DT = 0.05
+Q_DOWN = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0])
+
+
+def q_yaw(theta):
+    """Rotate a pen that points down by theta around world z."""
+    return np.array([0.0, math.cos(theta / 2), math.sin(theta / 2), 0.0])
+
+
+def poses_between(a, b, q, step_m=0.005):
+    """20 Hz straight Cartesian segment; keep each target increment small."""
+    a = np.asarray(a, dtype=float)
+    b = np.asarray(b, dtype=float)
+    n = max(1, int(math.ceil(np.linalg.norm(b - a) / step_m)))
+    xyz = np.linspace(a, b, n + 1)[1:]
+    return np.column_stack((xyz, np.tile(q, (n, 1))))
+
+
+def send_segment(r, a, b, q=Q_DOWN, step_m=0.005, note=""):
+    actions = poses_between(a, b, q, step_m)
+    # The protocol limits a submit to ten seconds / 400 rows.
+    allres = []
+    for i in range(0, len(actions), 190):
+        allres.append(r.submit("ee_pose", actions[i:i + 190], dt=DT, video="mp4", note=note))
+    return allres
+
+
+def send_hold(r, p, q=Q_DOWN, seconds=0.5, note=""):
+    row = np.r_[np.asarray(p, dtype=float), q]
+    actions = np.tile(row, (max(1, int(round(seconds / DT))), 1))
+    return r.submit("ee_pose", actions, dt=DT, video="mp4", note=note)
+
+
+def main():
+    r = Robot()
+    os.makedirs("/app/runs", exist_ok=True)
+    print("start", r.status())
+
+    # Locate the ink well from the scene camera/depth calibration.
+    ink = np.array([-0.100, 0.153, 0.024])
+    start = np.array(r.get_obs(cameras=["scene_cam"]).meta["proprio"]["now"][7:10])
+    send_segment(r, start, np.array([ink[0], ink[1], 0.060]), note="approach ink well")
+    send_segment(r, np.array([ink[0], ink[1], 0.060]), ink, step_m=0.002, note="dip")
+    send_hold(r, ink, seconds=0.5, note="load nib")
+    send_segment(r, ink, np.array([ink[0], ink[1], 0.070]), note="lift from ink")
+
+    # Three calibration strokes on the unscored practice sheet, along world x.
+    # Increasing penetration: 1.5, 2.5, and 5 mm below the paper surface.
+    tests = [
+        (-0.160, 0.0185, "practice 1.5 mm press"),
+        (-0.180, 0.0175, "practice 2.5 mm press"),
+        (-0.200, 0.0150, "practice 5 mm press"),
+    ]
+    for y, z, note in tests:
+        start_p = np.array([-0.020, y, 0.050])
+        contact_a = np.array([-0.020, y, z])
+        contact_b = np.array([-0.038, y, z])
+        send_segment(r, np.array([ink[0], ink[1], 0.070]), start_p, step_m=0.005, note="to practice")
+        send_segment(r, start_p, contact_a, step_m=0.002, note="lower practice nib")
+        send_segment(r, contact_a, contact_b, step_m=0.0006, note=note)
+        send_segment(r, contact_b, np.array([contact_b[0], contact_b[1], 0.050]), step_m=0.002, note="lift practice nib")
+        send_hold(r, np.array([contact_b[0], contact_b[1], 0.050]), seconds=0.1)
+
+    print("calibration complete", r.status())
+    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=["practice_cam", "scene_cam", "side_cam"])
+    for cam, image in obs.last.items():
+        from PIL import Image
+        Image.fromarray(image).save(f"/app/runs/cal_{cam}.png")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));

+"""RoboPaint strict lettering run: calibrate on practice and write `nun`."""
+import math
+import os
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+DT = 0.05
+SHEET_Z = 0.020
+MM_PER_PX = 0.22186
+SHEET_X_FAR = -0.100 + 0.227185 / 2
+SHEET_Y_LEFT = 0.227185 / 2
+Q_DOWN = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0])
+
+
+def q_yaw(theta):
+    """Down-pointing pen rotated around world z."""
+    return np.array([0.0, math.cos(theta / 2), math.sin(theta / 2), 0.0])
+
+
+def poses_between(a, b, q, step_m=0.005):
+    a, b = np.asarray(a, float), np.asarray(b, float)
+    n = max(1, int(math.ceil(np.linalg.norm(b - a) / step_m)))
+    xyz = np.linspace(a, b, n + 1)[1:]
+    return np.column_stack((xyz, np.tile(q, (n, 1))))
+
+
+def send_segment(r, a, b, q=Q_DOWN, step_m=0.005, note=""):
+    actions = poses_between(a, b, q, step_m)
+    results = []
+    for i in range(0, len(actions), 180):
+        results.append(r.submit("ee_pose", actions[i:i + 180], dt=DT, video="none", note=note))
+    return results
+
+
+def send_hold(r, p, q=Q_DOWN, seconds=0.5, note=""):
+    row = np.r_[np.asarray(p, float), q]
+    n = max(1, int(round(seconds / DT)))
+    return r.submit("ee_pose", np.tile(row, (n, 1)), dt=DT, video="none", note=note)
+
+
+def calibrate_on_practice(r):
+    """Dip once, then measure three press depths on the unscored sheet."""
+    ink = np.array([-0.100, 0.153, 0.024])
+    start = np.array(r.get_obs(cameras=[]).meta["proprio"]["now"][7:10])
+    send_segment(r, start, np.array([ink[0], ink[1], 0.060]), note="approach ink well")
+    send_segment(r, np.array([ink[0], ink[1], 0.060]), ink, step_m=0.002, note="dip")
+    send_hold(r, ink, seconds=0.5, note="load nib")
+    send_segment(r, ink, np.array([ink[0], ink[1], 0.070]), note="lift from ink")
+
+    tests = [(-0.160, 0.0185), (-0.180, 0.0175), (-0.200, 0.0150)]
+    current = np.array([ink[0], ink[1], 0.070])
+    for y, z in tests:
+        high = np.array([-0.020, y, 0.050])
+        a = np.array([-0.020, y, z])
+        b = np.array([-0.038, y, z])
+        send_segment(r, current, high, note="to practice")
+        send_segment(r, high, a, step_m=0.002, note="lower practice nib")
+        send_segment(r, a, b, step_m=0.0006, note="practice pressure line")
+        lifted = np.array([b[0], b[1], 0.050])
+        send_segment(r, b, lifted, step_m=0.002, note="lift practice nib")
+        current = lifted
+
+    p = np.array(r.get_obs(cameras=[]).meta["proprio"]["now"][7:10])
+    send_segment(r, p, np.array([p[0], p[1], 0.140]), note="clear practice sheet")
+    send_segment(r, np.array([p[0], p[1], 0.140]), np.array([-0.100, 0.153, 0.150]), note="park at ink well")
+
+
+def cubic(p0, c1, c2, p3, style):
+    return (np.asarray(p0, float), np.asarray(c1, float), np.asarray(c2, float), np.asarray(p3, float), style)
+
+
+def line(p0, p3, style):
+    p0, p3 = np.asarray(p0, float), np.asarray(p3, float)
+    return cubic(p0, p0 + (p3 - p0) / 3, p0 + 2 * (p3 - p0) / 3, p3, style)
+
+
+# Centerline reconstruction in target pixels. Each tuple is (P0, C1, C2, P3, style).
+# These trails follow the six diagonal pen forms and the thin connecting flourishes.
+STROKES = [
+    [
+        line((360, 532), (398, 508), "thin"),
+        line((398, 508), (368, 553), "bold"),
+    ],
+    [
+        cubic((398, 508), (405, 502), (429, 503), (426, 520), "thin"),
+        cubic((426, 520), (426, 529), (414, 541), (408, 547), "bold"),
+        cubic((408, 547), (433, 545), (471, 519), (496, 508), "thin"),
+        cubic((496, 508), (490, 521), (476, 542), (470, 554), "bold"),
+    ],

+        cubic((470, 554), (483, 558), (496, 545), (509, 538), "thin"),
+        cubic((509, 538), (518, 526), (527, 513), (533, 507), "bold"),
+    ],
+    [
+        line((509, 538), (507, 544), "thin"),
+        cubic((507, 544), (531, 542), (559, 523), (586, 515), "thin"),
+        line((586, 515), (595, 507), "bold"),
+        line((595, 507), (586, 515), "thin"),
+        cubic((586, 515), (581, 526), (572, 541), (564, 552), "bold"),
+    ],
+    [
+        cubic((620, 522), (628, 513), (609, 502), (586, 515), "thin"),
+        cubic((586, 515), (609, 502), (628, 513), (620, 522), "thin"),
+        cubic((620, 522), (617, 531), (610, 539), (605, 543), "bold"),
+        line((605, 543), (605, 556), "bold"),
+        cubic((605, 556), (619, 557), (640, 540), (653, 532), "thin"),
+    ],
+]
+
+
+def evaluate_cubic(seg, t):
+    p0, c1, c2, p3, _ = seg
+    s = 1.0 - t
+    p = s**3 * p0 + 3 * s**2 * t * c1 + 3 * s * t**2 * c2 + t**3 * p3
+    d = 3 * s**2 * (c1 - p0) + 6 * s * t * (c2 - c1) + 3 * t**2 * (p3 - c2)
+    return p, d
+
+
+def samples_for_segment(seg, spacing_px=2.0):
+    coarse = [evaluate_cubic(seg, t)[0] for t in np.linspace(0, 1, 101)]
+    length_px = float(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(coarse, axis=0), axis=1).sum())
+    n = max(2, int(math.ceil(length_px / spacing_px)))
+    samples = []
+    for t in np.linspace(0, 1, n + 1):
+        p, d = evaluate_cubic(seg, float(t))
+        samples.append((p, d, seg[4], length_px, float(t)))
+    return samples
+
+
+def wrap_nib_angle(theta):
+    # The two tines are symmetric, so yaw modulo pi gives the same nib direction.
+    return (theta + math.pi / 2) % math.pi - math.pi / 2
+
+
+def world_from_pixel(u, v):
+    # canvas_cam pixel orientation matches the exemplar: rows advance toward the robot.
+    x = SHEET_X_FAR - (v + 0.5) * MM_PER_PX / 1000.0
+    y = SHEET_Y_LEFT - (u + 0.5) * MM_PER_PX / 1000.0
+    return x, y
+
+
+def action_rows_for_stroke(segments, spacing_px=2.0):
+    rows = []
+    for seg in segments:
+        pts = samples_for_segment(seg, spacing_px)
+        if rows:
+            pts = pts[1:]
+        for p, derivative, style, length_px, t in pts:
+            # A light contact makes hairlines; deepen and taper broad downstrokes.
+            if style == "bold":
+                ramp_px = 8.0
+                edge_fraction = min(1.0, (t * length_px) / ramp_px, ((1 - t) * length_px) / ramp_px)
+                smooth = edge_fraction * edge_fraction * (3 - 2 * edge_fraction)
+                press_mm = 0.8 + (4.5 - 0.8) * smooth
+            else:
+                press_mm = 0.8
+            z = SHEET_Z - press_mm / 1000.0
+
+            # Pixel tangent to world tangent (paper X grows upward in the image).
+            dx = -derivative[1]
+            dy = -derivative[0]
+            phi = math.atan2(dy, dx)
+            theta = phi if style == "bold" else (-math.pi / 2 - phi)
+            theta = wrap_nib_angle(theta)
+            q = q_yaw(theta)
+            x, y = world_from_pixel(float(p[0]), float(p[1]))
+            rows.append([x, y, z, *q])
+    return np.asarray(rows, dtype=float)
+
+
+def write_stroke(r, index, segments):
+    rows = action_rows_for_stroke(segments)
+    first, last = rows[0], rows[-1]
+    now = np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=[]).meta["proprio"]["now"][7:14], float)
+    current = now[:3]
+    q_current = now[3:]
+    safe = np.array([first[0], first[1], 0.075])
+    send_segment(r, current, np.array([current[0], current[1], max(current[2], 0.075)]), q=q_current, note=f"lift before stroke {index}")
+    safe_start = np.r_[safe, Q_DOWN]
+    safe_end = np.r_[safe, first[3:7]]
+    # Move at a safe height, then lower to contact with the stroke's first nib angle.
+    transit = poses_between(safe[:3], safe[:3], Q_DOWN)
+    transit = transit[:, :]  # keep shape explicit for the empty XY leg
+    p_high = np.r_[first[:2], 0.075]
+    if np.linalg.norm(safe[:2] - p_high[:2]) > 1e-6:
+        send_segment(r, safe[:3], p_high, q=Q_DOWN, note=f"position for stroke {index}")
+    send_segment(r, p_high, first[:3], q=first[3:7], step_m=0.0015, note=f"lower for stroke {index}")
+
+    for i in range(0, len(rows), 180):
+        result = r.submit("ee_pose", rows[i:i + 180], dt=DT, video="none", note=f"main lettering stroke {index}")
+        if result.meta.get("plan"):
+            fails = [p for p in result.meta["plan"] if p.get("ik_ok") is False or p.get("ik") is False]
+            if fails:
+                print("IK plan warning", index, fails[:3])
+    end = np.array([last[0], last[1], 0.075])
+    send_segment(r, last[:3], end, q=last[3:7], step_m=0.002, note=f"lift after stroke {index}")
+    print("stroke", index, "rows", len(rows), "status", r.status())
+
+
+def make_preview(path="/app/runs/planned_overlay.png"):
+    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
+
+    image = Image.open("/app/target.png").convert("RGB")
+    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(image)
+    colors = [(220, 30, 30), (20, 80, 230), (0, 160, 80), (210, 120, 0), (170, 40, 190)]
+    for si, stroke in enumerate(STROKES):
+        color = colors[si]
+        for seg in stroke:
+            pts = [evaluate_cubic(seg, t)[0] for t in np.linspace(0, 1, max(5, int(samples_for_segment(seg)[-1][3])))]
+            draw.line([tuple(p) for p in pts], fill=color, width=1)
+    image.crop((340, 490, 670, 570)).resize((1320, 320)).save(path)
+
+
+def write_main(r):
+    os.makedirs("/app/runs", exist_ok=True)
+    make_preview()
+    for i, stroke in enumerate(STROKES, 1):
+        write_stroke(r, i, stroke)
+    # Park outside the word so the recorded final frame shows the lettering.
+    now = np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=[]).meta["proprio"]["now"][7:14], float)
+    send_segment(r, now[:3], np.array([now[0], now[1], 0.140]), q=now[3:], note="clear finished lettering")
+    send_segment(r, np.array([now[0], now[1], 0.140]), np.array([-0.100, 0.153, 0.150]), note="park after lettering")
+    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=["canvas_cam", "scene_cam", "side_cam"])
+    from PIL import Image
+    for cam, frame in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(f"/app/runs/final_{cam}.png")
+    print("final status", r.status())
+
+
+def main():
+    r = Robot()
+    mode = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "--calibrate-and-write"
+    print("start", r.status())
+    if mode == "--calibrate-and-write":

+        raise SystemExit("Use --calibrate-and-write or --write-main-only")
+    write_main(r)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
